units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 21:6">Targ. II Kings XXI, 6</cite>.
Ib. XVII, 17 (ed. Wil. ונְחִישׁוּ Pe.); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 95b:13">Ḥull. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>דנָחֵישׁ</he> because he had made his movements dependent on an omen.
<cite ref="Yevamot 120b:5">Yeb. 120ᵇ</cite> <he>כיס … מְנַחֲשֵׁי אינשי וכ׳</he> as to purse and bag people are superstitious and do not lend them; a. e.
